why: The main conjunct corollary_15_3_10_1 assumes, besides B's hypotheses, sc-smooth bump functions (pointwise reading AdmitsBumpFunctionsPointwise) and the tame-germ hypothesis A.B.IsScFredholmSectionTame f; B has neither, so A => B is not available (A => Bplus, B with both added, is proved, with 'tame' of Θ from theorem_15_3_7_in_particular_tame_hyp). B => main conjunct is proved: B gives all but general position, which for d_X ≡ 0 follows from transversality (gp_of_transversal_deg0, via chart-independence of T^R_xX). B => all of A is not available only because of the conjunct theorem_15_3_7_of_paracompact (Theorem 15.3.7 for every A, without d_X ≡ 0), which B does not give; the remaining conjuncts are proved from B (B_to_A_rest).
B_issue: B quotes no bump-function hypothesis (the text's Theorem 15.3.7, on which the corollary rests, assumes one); B's own comment flags this. B is then stronger than the project's corollary.
overlap: B_to_main: 509 shared project theorems, all infrastructure (chart-independence of the reduced tangent space, Proposition 2.4.10 and charts/retractions); B_to_A_rest: 1487 (in addition the sc-Fredholm and auxiliary-norm lemmas of the R x R example); no Chapter 15 perturbation theorem is shared
